dish_name_kh: ឆាគ្រឿងសាច់ត្រី
dish_name_en: Cha Kroeung Sach Trei (Stir-fried Fish with Spice Paste)

ingredients.raw_kh: ត្រីកេសរំពាង
សំបកផ្លែក្រូចសើច

steps.text_kh: ត្រីស្រកាចេញ ហាន់ជាបន្ទះស្តើងល្មមប៉ុនៗមេដៃ សណ្តែកដីលីងបុក កុំឱ្យម៉ដ្ឋពេកទុកសិន
steps.text_en: Descale the fish and slice into thumb-sized strips; roast and crush peanuts, not too finely; set aside.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer cha dish Cha Kroeung Sach Trei (Stir-fried Fish with Spice Paste), step 1: Descale the fish and slice into thumb-sized strips; roast and crush peanuts, not too finely; set aside.

steps.text_kh: ស្លឹកគ្រៃ ខ្ជាយ រមៀត ខ្ទឹមស រំដេង សំបកផ្លែក្រូចសើច បុកឱ្យម៉ដ្ឋ
steps.text_en: Pound lemongrass, fingerroot, turmeric, garlic, galangal, and kaffir lime zest until smooth.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer cha dish Cha Kroeung Sach Trei (Stir-fried Fish with Spice Paste), step 2: Pound lemongrass, fingerroot, turmeric, garlic, galangal, and kaffir lime zest until smooth.

steps.text_kh: យកខ្ទះដាក់ខ្លាញ់ដាំឱ្យក្តៅ ដាក់ស្លឹកគ្រៃដែលបុកនោះឱ្យឈ្ងុយ ទើបដាក់ត្រីចូល ចាក់ទឹកត្រី អំបិល ស្ករ ម្សៅស៊ុប ឆាឱ្យឆ្អិន ភ្លក់មើលឱ្យល្មមតាមចូលចិត្ត
steps.text_en: Heat a wok with oil, fry the pounded paste until fragrant, add the fish, season with fish sauce, salt, sugar, and soup powder; stir-fry until cooked; taste and adjust.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer cha dish Cha Kroeung Sach Trei (Stir-fried Fish with Spice Paste), step 3: Heat a wok with oil, fry the pounded paste until fragrant, add the fish, season with fish sauce, salt, sugar, and soup powder; stir-fry until cooked; taste and adjust.
